nodes.description: SunBlocks constructor: ERC721('SunBlocks','SBLOCKS') + RandomlyAssigned(555,1), Ownable sets deployer as owner.
mint(uint256) payable public: checks paused, amount bounds, supply caps and payment, then mints via nextToken/_safeMint and updates publicSupplyMinted after the loop.
presaleMint(uint256) payable public: uses presaleList[msg.sender] allowance, mints tokens then decrements allowance and increments presaleSupplyMinted after the loop.
addPresaleList(address[],uint256[]) onlyOwner: bulk-assigns presale allowances into presaleList.
setBaseURI(string) onlyOwner: writes baseURI state variable.
withdraw() payable onlyOwner: sends the entire contract balance to msg.sender with a low-level send.
tokenURI(uint256) view: checks _exists, concatenates baseURI + tokenId + baseExtension.
walletOfOwner(address) view: returns the token ids owned by an address.
_baseURI() internal view override: returns the baseURI state variable.
RandomlyAssigned.nextToken() internal override: derives an index from block values (msg.sender, coinbase, difficulty, gaslimit, timestamp), swaps in tokenMatrix and calls super.nextToken().
WithLimitedSupply.nextToken() internal virtual ensureAvailability: reads current count, increments _tokenCount and returns the token id.
maxSupply() public view: returns _maxSupply.
availableTokenCount() public view: maxSupply() - tokenCount().
modifier ensureAvailability: requires availableTokenCount() > 0.
modifier onlyOwner: requires owner() == _msgSender().
owner() public view virtual: returns _owner.
_setOwner(address) private: writes _owner and emits OwnershipTransferred.
ERC721._safeMint(address,uint256[,bytes]) internal virtual: _mint plus _checkOnERC721Received.
ERC721._mint(address,uint256) internal virtual: checks zero address and existence, updates _balances/_owners, emits Transfer.
ERC721._checkOnERC721Received private: makes an external try-call to IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received on the receiving contract.
ERC721Enumerable._beforeTokenTransfer hook: updates all-token and owner-token enumerations on mint/burn/transfer.
Context._msgSender() internal view virtual: returns msg.sender.
uint256 public cost = 0.0277 ether (price per token).
uint256 public maxMintAmount = 10 (per-transaction mint cap).
uint256 public maxBlocksSupply = 555 (hard total supply for minting).
bool public paused = false (global mint switch).
uint public publicSupplyMinted = 0 (counter of public mints).
uint public publicMaxSupply = 485 (cap for public minting).
uint public presaleSupplyMinted = 0 (counter of presale mints).
uint public presaleMaxSupply = 70 (cap for presale minting).
mapping(address => uint256) public presaleList: per-address presale allowance.
string public baseURI (metadata base used by _baseURI).
string public baseExtension = '.json' appended in tokenURI.
Counters.Counter private _tokenCount in WithLimitedSupply.
uint256 private _maxSupply in WithLimitedSupply, set by constructor.
mapping(uint256 => uint256) private tokenMatrix used for random token id assignment.
uint256 private startFrom, initial token id offset.
address private _owner in Ownable, controls onlyOwner functions.
msg.sender: caller address, used as mint recipient, presaleList lookup key, owner check and withdraw recipient.
block.timestamp: miner-influenceable value used as part of the nextToken randomness seed.
low-level native send of the whole balance to msg.sender inside withdraw (require(payable(msg.sender).send(address(this).balance))).
pseudo-random token index = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(msg.sender, block.coinbase, block.difficulty, block.gaslimit, block.timestamp))) % maxIndex.
external callback IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(_msgSender(), from, tokenId, data) executed during _safeMint.
parameter _mintAmount of SunBlocks.mint.
parameter _mintAmount of SunBlocks.presaleMint.
local mintIndex = nextToken() inside presaleMint loop.
local senderLimit caching presaleList[msg.sender] allowance in presaleMint.
local mintIndex = nextToken() inside mint loop.
loop counter i in mint.
loop counter i in presaleMint.
parameter _addrs (address[]) of addPresaleList.
parameter _limit (uint256[]) of addPresaleList.
loop counter i in addPresaleList.
parameter _newBaseURI of setBaseURI.
parameter _owner of walletOfOwner.
local ownerTokenCount = balanceOf(_owner) in walletOfOwner.
local tokenIds array built in walletOfOwner.
loop counter i in walletOfOwner.
parameter tokenId of tokenURI.
local currentBaseURI = _baseURI() in tokenURI.
local maxIndex = maxSupply() - tokenCount() in RandomlyAssigned.nextToken.
local random index derived from block values modulo maxIndex.
local value chosen from tokenMatrix (or random) as the assigned token id.
local token = _tokenCount.current() in WithLimitedSupply.nextToken.

edges.reason: mint uses _msgSender() (msg.sender) as the recipient address of _safeMint.
_mintAmount parameter controls the number of loop iterations and payment required in mint.
loop counter i drives the mint loop in mint.
mint requires _mintAmount <= maxMintAmount.
mint requires !paused, reading the paused state variable.
mint checks totalSupply() + _mintAmount <= maxBlocksSupply.
mint reads and later increments publicSupplyMinted after the mint loop.
mint checks publicSupplyMinted + _mintAmount <= publicMaxSupply.
mint computes msg.value >= cost * _mintAmount, an arithmetic price computation.
mint calls nextToken() once per token inside the loop.
mint calls _safeMint to create each token.
_mintAmount parameter controls the presaleMint loop and allowance consumption.
loop counter i drives the presaleMint loop.
presaleMint uses msg.sender as the presaleList lookup key and mint recipient.
presaleMint reads and writes presaleList[msg.sender] allowance.
presaleMint checks and increments presaleSupplyMinted.
presaleMint checks presaleSupplyMinted + _mintAmount <= presaleMaxSupply.
presaleMint requires !paused.
presaleMint requires _mintAmount <= maxMintAmount.
presaleMint calls nextToken() for each token.
presaleMint calls _safeMint for each token.
mintIndex stores the nextToken() result before _safeMint in presaleMint.
senderLimit local tracks and decrements the caller's presale allowance.
_addrs parameter supplies the addresses written into presaleList.
_limit parameter supplies the allowances written into presaleList.
loop counter i iterates over _addrs in addPresaleList.
owner-only function writes presaleList allowances for arbitrary addresses.
onlyOwner modifier guards addPresaleList.
onlyOwner modifier guards setBaseURI.
onlyOwner modifier guards withdraw.
onlyOwner compares _msgSender() (msg.sender) against owner().
onlyOwner modifier calls owner() for the authorization check.
owner() reads the _owner state variable.
_newBaseURI parameter is assigned to baseURI.
setBaseURI writes the baseURI state variable (owner-only).
withdraw sends the entire contract balance through a low-level send to msg.sender.
msg.sender is the recipient of the balance transfer in withdraw.
the send transfers gas to msg.sender, which may re-enter mint before state updates complete.
the recipient of withdraw can re-enter withdraw before the balance is consumed.
RandomlyAssigned.nextToken computes a pseudo-random index inside the unsafe operation.
block.timestamp feeds the keccak256 random seed used for token id assignment.
the derived random index selects a slot in tokenMatrix.
nextToken reads and writes tokenMatrix during the swap-style assignment.
RandomlyAssigned.nextToken calls super.nextToken() to increment the counter.
WithLimitedSupply.nextToken reads and increments _tokenCount.
ensureAvailability modifier guards nextToken in WithLimitedSupply.
the ensureAvailability check calls availableTokenCount().
availableTokenCount calls maxSupply().
availableTokenCount computes maxSupply() - tokenCount(), a subtraction that could underflow.
maxSupply() returns the _maxSupply state variable.
maxIndex local bounds the random index inside nextToken.
random local stores the generated index used for tokenMatrix access.
value local holds the assigned token id returned by nextToken.
token local stores _tokenCount.current() in WithLimitedSupply.nextToken.
nextToken returns value + startFrom using the startFrom state variable.
_safeMint calls _mint to create the token.
_mint triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer hook for enumeration updates.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received after minting.
_checkOnERC721Received makes an external call to onERC721Received on the receiving contract.
_msgSender() (msg.sender) is passed as the operator argument of onERC721Received.
a malicious receiver can re-enter mint from onERC721Received before publicSupplyMinted is updated.
a malicious receiver can re-enter presaleMint before presaleList allowance and counters are updated.
_owner parameter selects whose balance and tokens are enumerated in walletOfOwner.
ownerTokenCount sizes the returned token id array.
tokenIds array holds the enumeration results returned by walletOfOwner.
loop counter i drives tokenOfOwnerByIndex enumeration.
tokenId parameter is used in the existence check and URI concatenation.
currentBaseURI local is the base obtained from _baseURI().
tokenURI calls _baseURI() to build the URI.
_baseURI() returns the baseURI state variable.
tokenURI appends baseExtension to the token id.
constructor sets _maxSupply through the WithLimitedSupply constructor.
constructor sets startFrom through the RandomlyAssigned constructor.
constructor initializes the _owner state variable.
the deployer (msg.sender) becomes the initial owner.
_setOwner writes the _owner state variable.
_msgSender() returns msg.sender.
onlyOwner uses _msgSender() for the caller comparison.
